text: Mara cuts each linen cover at the long table behind her shop. The corners take most of the time. A finished book then sits under weight overnight so the boards dry flat.
The tray measures 24 centimetres across and weighs 680 grams. It fits four mugs. The raised rim catches small spills before they reach the table.
This template works in the desktop version of Numbers. It does not open correctly in Excel 2016, and we would rather say that now than leave you repairing formulas later.
Bookings cover addresses within 12 kilometres of Newtown. Stairs are fine. Jobs above the third floor need lift access because the repair stand weighs 31 kilograms.
Return an unused item within 30 days. Start by replying to the dispatch email; we will send the address and a reference number. Refunds go back to the original card after the parcel is checked.
Orders placed before noon leave on Tuesday or Thursday. We send the tracking link once the carrier scans the parcel. Rural deliveries usually need two extra days.
In our April test, seven of ten riders finished the setup in under four minutes. That is a small sample, so we use it as a usability check rather than a market claim.
Made in Marrickville. Built to be repaired, with four ordinary screws and no glued shell.
Your first lesson arrives immediately after payment. The remaining four arrive each Monday at 8 am Sydney time, unless you pause the sequence from the receipt page.
We do not yet know whether the oak finish will darken near a sunny window. The supplier expects some change after six months. We are testing a sample now and will publish the photographs.
